description: Correspondence from Mabel Ludlum to various correspondents: 1. Letter to Mr. Macrae, Feb. 25, 1932, with six chapters of the manuscript by Amelia Martinez del Rio discussed in the letter. 2. Letter to Ethel Barr, Aug. 25, [1931], written on the back of a 1931 Essex County Garden Club flyer. 3. Letter to Ethel Barr, July 15, 1941. Correspondence from various correspondents to Mabel Ludlum: 1. Letter from Helen Chapman, Dec. 1929. 2. Letter from Margretta Stewart Dietrich, March 21, [no year, possibly 1933]. 3. Letter with an envelope, posted Jan. 7, 1937, from Theodora Goddard. The letter is dated Oct. 12, [1936, based on the postmark on the forwarding envelope.] 4. Letter from Anna Johnson, Aug. 8, 1937. 5. Postcard from "Josephine" [no last name and the postmark is illegible.] 6. Letter from Delia Stewart Lewis, undated.
title: Mabel Ludlum to and from various correspondents
